summary: The Acer Aspire 5 15 is a budget-friendly laptop that has shown promise despite its limitations. The Ryzen 7 5800H processor and RX 5500M graphics card provide decent performance, but thermal throttling issues have been reported. Driver updates and BIOS revisions have helped improve performance, but the laptop still struggles with heat management.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to inadequate cooling system
suggested_solution: Upgrade to a more powerful processor or graphics card, invest in high-quality thermal paste and thermal pads, monitor system temperatures closely and adjust cooling settings as needed
